source: New for Sheepcliff (#41), migrated to the v2 card schema for #59 so the engine (#40) is built against it, not v1.
comment: The farm's event deck. The engine (packages/sim, #40) draws a card whose conditions hold, weighted live by its multipliers, respecting its limits; runs its start hooks; ends it after its duration with the end hooks. Every card has a beat the player sees within one second. Cozy only: nothing here hurts anyone. DL's birthday and first snow moved to events/authored.json for #59 (plan section 2 names them as the punctuation cards don't do); flockHuddle and farmerMeetsMerchant are new so the deck stays at fifteen.

timeScale.comment: One sim day is the clock's 180-second period when watching, so a sim minute is 0.125 real seconds and a sim hour is 7.5 real seconds. When away, a sim day is about a real day.

start.comment: Fog layer over the field; the barn and the tree stay as shapes.

start.name: fog
start.comment: Sheep drift closer together; DL walks the edge of the field.

storybook.line: A fog came down at dawn and {dl} counted the flock by their bleats.

beat.start: The field greys out to shapes within a second; the flock bunches up.
beat.end: The fog thins from the top down and the barn's red comes back first.

multipliers.comment: Plenty of grazing left standing reads as hay worth stealing.

start.comment: Three crows land on and around the hay bale.
The sheep do not like being watched.

end.comment: She chased them off. Good dog.

storybook.line: Three crows landed on the hay and {dl} sent them packing.

beat.start: Three crows drop onto the hay bale; the nearest sheep backs off a step.
beat.end: DL runs at them, they scatter over the fence, she trots back with her tail up.

events.title: Lost lamb
events.comment: Write-up: docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "Lost lamb". `lambFarFromMother` is PROPOSED to sim on #40.

multipliers.comment: This is what "lost" means; the strongest driver, once sim on #40 can produce it (see the card comment: PROPOSED, not true in today's sim).
DL was not close enough to notice it slip out.

start.name: lambLost
start.comment: The sim picks a lamb and walks it out past the outer gate; DL's fetch-the-lamb behaviour reads this.
Its mother calls.

storybook.line: {lamb} wandered off at dusk and {dl} brought them home before dark.

beat.start: A lamb slips out the gate; its mother stands up and bleats after it.
beat.end: DL walks the lamb back through the gate, slowly, right behind it, and the ewe meets them.

events.title: Merchant caravan
events.comment: Write-up and the KNOWN GAP (three code paths still sell wool on this card): docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "Merchant caravan". Owner's decision 12: no transaction on the farm; data has no coins/wool hook.

conditions.comment: Daytime only now (was day or dusk): a road event has no reason to keep the old trade window, and 'daytime' is the issue's own word for it.

start.comment: Puts the cart on the lane so the moment has a beat to see. No coins hook, no wool hook: the farm's stock does not move from this card's own data. See the card comment for the known code-path gap this alone cannot close.

storybook.line: A caravan rolled along the lane and {dl} trotted the fence to watch it pass.

beat.start: The cart rolls along the lane past the outer gate; the sheep look up and DL trots to the fence.
beat.end: The cart carries on down the lane and out of sight; the flock goes back to grazing.

conditions.comment: The flock's mean fleece is already more than half grown; this is a day whose time has come, not a random draw.

multipliers.comment: The fuller the flock already is, the readier the day.

start.name: shearingDay
start.comment: Every fleece is ready; the farmer's shear job keeps re-queuing until the field is trim.
An extra visit outside farmer.visitsAt.

storybook.line: Shearing day. The farmer clipped {flock} fleeces and the sheep felt the breeze.

beat.start: Every sheep on the field goes fluffy at once; the farmer walks in with the shears bubble.
beat.end: The last sheep is trim, the wool bank is full, and the flock does a little hop.

events.title: Rainbow after rain
events.comment: Write-up: docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "Rainbow after rain". `simMinutesSinceRain` is PROPOSED to sim on #40.

start.name: rainbow
start.comment: A rainbow arc over the barn on the weather layer.

storybook.line: The rain stopped and a rainbow stood over the barn for a while.

beat.start: The arc fades in over the barn as the last drops fall; the sheep come out of the doorway.
beat.end: It fades from the outside in and is gone.

events.title: A stray cat visits
events.comment: Write-up: docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "A stray cat visits". Cat is a new creature (High gate for art/behaviour).

multipliers.comment: A settled flock is a quieter field for a cautious visitor.

start.comment: Walks in along the fence and settles on the post nearest the gate.

storybook.line: A stray cat sat on the fence at dusk. {dl} pretended not to care.

beat.start: A cat pads in along the fence; DL freezes mid-step and stares.
beat.end: The cat hops down and leaves the way it came; DL does a stretch as if she meant it.

start.name: farmerAway
start.comment: The farmer's clock schedule is skipped while set; DL visits the trough, the hay, and each sheep in turn.
Nobody topped up the trough.

storybook.line: The farmer took the day off, so {dl} did the rounds herself.

beat.start: The gate stays shut at the usual time; DL trots to the trough and looks into it.
beat.end: The farmer is back next morning with a heart bubble for DL.

multipliers.comment: A settled flock means DL is free to bounce after lights instead of minding sheep.

start.comment: A drifting swarm from the tree across the field.

start.name: fireflies
start.comment: DL's idle play prefers snapping at fireflies while set.

storybook.line: Fireflies filled the field and {dl} snapped at every one and caught none.

beat.start: A dozen lights blink on around the tree and drift out; DL bounces after the nearest.
beat.end: The lights thin out one by one and DL sits down, panting.

multipliers.comment: A calm flock, not a stressed one, is when a lamb plays.

start.name: zoomies
start.comment: Lambs run laps of the trough at DL's run speed; DL may join.

storybook.line: {lamb} got the zoomies and ran rings round the trough.

beat.start: A lamb bolts from its mother's side and tears round the trough.
beat.end: It stops dead, wobbles, and lies down next to its mother.

events.title: The well runs low
events.comment: Write-up: docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "The well runs low". Drop bubble is an art ask.

conditions.comment: The mean tuft level reads parched, not just dry-ish.

multipliers.comment: Nobody around yet to top it up before it gets bad.

start.name: troughLow
start.comment: The trough draws empty; drinking gives less; sheep gather round it.

end.comment: An extra visit: the farmer walks in and the trough job refills it.

storybook.line: The well ran low in the heat until the farmer came with buckets.

beat.start: The trough's water drops to a line; a drop bubble over the nearest sheep.
beat.end: The farmer walks in, tops it up, and the queue breaks up drinking.

events.title: A windfall
events.comment: Write-up: docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "A windfall". Owner's decision 12: no transaction on the farm, so no coins hook.

start.comment: The find itself is the moment; no coins hook, no ledger stock moves.

storybook.line: {dl} dug up something bright by the tree, and nobody asked whose it was.

beat.start: DL digs at the foot of the tree and comes up with something in her teeth.
beat.end: She trots back to the field with her nose muddy, pleased with herself.

multipliers.comment: A scattered flock does not settle down together to watch the sky.

start.name: starsBright
start.comment: More and brighter stars on the night sky; sheep lie down facing up; DL sits by the gate.

storybook.line: A clear night. {dl} sat by the gate and watched the stars with the flock.

beat.start: The stars come up bright; DL sits down by the gate with her head tipped back.
beat.end: The sky dims to its usual night and DL walks to the barn door to sleep.

events.title: Rain, and a flock to gather
events.comment: Write-up: docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "Rain, and a flock to gather".

multipliers.comment: A bigger job, a bigger moment, when she has further to run.

start.name: gathering
start.comment: DL's rain-shepherd priority reads this and beelines for the furthest sheep first.
Rain, and no one gathering them in yet.

end.comment: Safe and dry under the barn eave.

storybook.line: Rain caught the flock scattered and {dl} gathered every one of them in.

beat.start: The rain starts and the flock startles apart; DL breaks into a run toward the furthest one.
beat.end: The last sheep is walked in under the barn eave and DL circles the group once, checking.

events.title: The farmer meets the merchant
events.comment: Write-up: docs/content/EVENT_DECK.md, "The farmer meets the merchant".

start.name: crossing
start.comment: Cosmetic only: the two NPCs pause to talk instead of following their separate plans for a moment.

end.comment: Two of her favourite visitors at once.

storybook.line: The farmer and the merchant crossed paths on the lane and {dl} sat between them.

beat.start: The merchant's cart rolls in just as the farmer is finishing his rounds; they stop to talk.
beat.end: They go their separate ways, the farmer to the gate, the cart down the lane, and DL trots off after her nose.
